label: Illustrative example: checking a supplier bill read from an emailed PDF, with the supplier matched, how sure each field is and the two things to check before the draft bill is made.
title: RRH-Sept-invoice.pdf
subtitle: Email from Kemi, Monday 19 October 09:12 · 1 page · read as a supplier bill

blocks.title: The original: lines read from the picture
2 to check before you make the draft

items.title: Due date was worked out
items.body: The bill says “14 days”, so the date comes from the invoice date. Check it.

items.title: VAT read as exempt
items.body: The bill says “exempt service”. If it is not, the tax on the bill changes by ₦109,125.

items.title: The lines add up
items.body: 4 lines come to ₦1,455,000, less ₦5,000 discount, to ₦1,450,000.

items.title: No possible duplicate
items.body: No other bill from Ring Road Haulage has this number or amount. Nothing is posted: this makes a draft bill for you to open, check and submit.
